name: 首页按最新PSD更新 + 唱片转场 + 关卡掉落可读性
notice: 首页换成最新设计：左上唱片播放器（点它切歌）、右侧设置/邮件/眼睛（点眼睛隐藏界面）；开始演出和返回大厅加入唱片转场；关卡掉落名称、稀有度和掉率更清楚。
unityBuild: Unity 6000.6.0f1 R70: home layout from CHO-SIREN-Home-Layered-v3 (2026-10-19): character moved to the PSD position, entry cards back to authored size, record player widget (spinning disc with screen-blended cover, live song title, tap = next song), eye button toggles lobby UI; idle/sign-in/guide cards removed from the lobby (still reachable via daily tasks). New VinylStageTransition (black streak → spinning vinyl → diagonal reveal of the idol close-up with CHO-SIREN / NAME / CLAN banner) for lobby → map and map → lobby. Stage drop panel: larger outlined text, rarity-coloured names with tier rim, per-item drop-rate chips.
